review_description: I received installer recommendations through solar quotes. I decided to go with Frazer Ekectrical. The owner Ben Frazer clearly explained my options, based on my present solar system and my larger monthly bills even with my 8kw Fronius inverter. I did pay more than I had originally budgeted but I now have 18.6Kw of panels on my roof along with a sigenergy 32.4kw battery and a 20kw inverter. Only had the install yesterday so time will tell. Too early to say what affect this will have but the service and quality of the install was great,
All the process was greatQuoting was done in a informative way and promptlyInstallation was done as quoted

Quoting process was great and their price was much cheaper than others. Service and install was quick and seamless.Only one slight issue with booking the install dates where they changed dates and did not let me know. Luckily I had followed up with them to confirm which is when I found out. But once I spoke to them we were able to arrange a suitable day.Commissioning and explanation of the system was great.

They did everything perfectly. A great bunch of guys, friendly courteous, knowledgeable and extremely competent. Kept us informed throughout and gave a full rundown of the system, how it works and how to use it at the finish.
Everything from start to finish was excellent. Workmanship fantastic and installed in one day.
Quotation and explanation  of the system itself was very good.  Installation went well in a day. System has been performing well. No post installation contact as yet, but is just gone 1 month.
Quote matched our requirements. No sales pressure quote,  explicit and honest answers to our questions

Ben visited before quoting, which I much appreciated.Installation was faster than expected, as I jumped into an unexpected opening in their calendar. The team arrived on time, and were all polite and tidy. I also had a minor follow up adjustment which was sorted without me needing to be home.Overall communications were great. The system was working by 3pm on the day of installation - all I had to do was call my provider and let them know I'd upgraded. Easy-peasy. The installer explained how it worked, and showed me the app.The Enphase app is terrific - I'm nerding out on the detail provided and annoying my family by talking too much about it! ? I'm looking forward to monitoring my future use and learning to make best use of the free power (ignoring system costs)
Good installation with just a minor delay. Helped organise grid connection.
Frazer electrical were happy to answer any quick had. They showed up on time and did a great job.
Great experience from first contact to final bill. The team were friendly and professional and the system went in without a hassle. Highly recommend.

Got my Enphase Batteries installed Dec 2024 and so far so good. Batteries seem to be operating as you would expect and look very neat and tidy on the wall of my garage. Frazer Electrical were terrific to deal with as I did ask for some additional work to be done, such as move my current Invertor and re-jig power and data points......just to make the whole package look a bit neater. Their pricing was concise and there were no surprise charges at the end of the job.

Was all done in a timely manner from the time I said let’s get some quotes from SolarQuotes  I was always in the know  throughout the process Frazer Electrical Group did an outstanding job throughout the whole process
Efficient and thorough quoting process. Polite, punctual and diligent installers. Good customer service with after sales follow up.
Great people to deal with Ben and the team were true pro's
Very helpful reliable service did a good jobWe’re very knowledgeable

The quoting process was quick and easy and they provided multiple quotes and were able to change and add to them quickly upon request. The installers were polite, punctual and thorough. They organised the grid connection and returned to the home to finish off setup once our wifi was setup.

Ben from Frazer Electrical contacted me within a day.Well spoken, patient and smart. I got good advice (not an upsell) on what I needed with all the pros and cons to the options.Two of his staff came the next day to check the site and quote - they were both very friendly and easy going young blokes. I had my quote the next day and just after Xmas closure I had my system installed.It was done well and it was great service. The price was really competitive and hence the experience was what got the business over the cheaper, won't leave ya online commission chasing alternative.If ya believe in quality and supporting local businesses than Frazer Electrical are a fantastic choice.
Quote process was smooth and efficient. Installer provided good communication and follow-up support with a few minor teething issues - Support provided until the issues were resolved - great outcome!

Prompt Quote and reasonable. The installation was quick and efficient and they took the old stuff away for free, and did the grid connect, i would highly reccommend Ben and his Frazer Electrical Group for any work around the house.

Ben came to my house fairly promptly. Explained the process to me and how he would do the job. I was happy with his quote and his expertise. He was very punctual and was always there when he said he was going to be. I accepted his quote and the job was done not long after. I thought that he and his team done a very professional job. I am an electrical tradesman myself and was happy with the workmanship. He helped organize the grid connection and now it is all up and running. I am  yet to receive my first bill, to see if I have any savings. I would recommend Frazer Electrical.
From start to finish was excellent , any questions I had was answered promptly , installed earlier than expected date , I organized the grid connection
The quote was given by an electrician who knows his subject, was keen to get the job, personally supervised the work and resolved an issue regarding the rebate.

Professional installer who took time to explain different options, negotiated placement of panels on-site, answered all my questions clearly and communicate every step of the process. After installation was completed Ben explained what needed to be done on my part with my provider and set up the monitoring process. I highly recommend this company.
Quick turnaround from start to finish, excellent service and quality products.
Great team of guys who installed the solar, no mess, no fuss. Great job.
Requested quote late Friday was there Saturday no pressure great communication willing to listen and understand my needs offer solutions and advice couldn’t be better

From our first contact with Ben the customer service has been exceptional from Frazer Electrical.  We changed our design about 4 times and each time Ben updated my array plan. Ben came out for a measure and we decided to go with a 9.75kW system which was installed without any dramas in a day.  Mind you it was a long day for Ben and his team but all completed in 10hours!I would recommend anyone considering solar to speak with Frazer prior to making a decision.

As a retired electrician I was very impressed with the professionalism of Ben Frazer and the Frazer Electrical team. A partly shaded roof made the upgrade of our old 3.6KW system challenging with a number of companies opting out from quoting. Ben however was never phased. He designed a system using micro-inverter panels and 3 phase inverter which performs very well. The system was installed early in January and has performed admirably ever since. The “Enphase” app allows real time monitoring of the system and has shown that already we are producing substantially more electricity than we expected. We will be closely monitoring the system over the next 12 months to assess if the connection of a battery in the future is warranted. We are very happy with the system and recommend, without hesitation, Ben Frazer and Frazer Electrical Group to other prospective customers.

Ben was a pleasure to do business with him and his team did a great job getting my solar panels connected all in a day with no mess very professional from the time he measured the job till finish .Thanks Ben and team ..

Contact from Frazier was same day then   visit to the site the next day. I received a quote and panel layout the following day. Then I received a follow up call  to make sure I received and was happy with everything on the quote.  4 days later after I received 2 other quotes from companies that only quoted using Google Earth to view the property. We decided to go with Frazier. The complete installation has been done in 10 days. Now just waiting for connection.Very prompt and professional service. Awesome to see the day and age.
